children: Brunello Cucinelli has once again shown itself resilient in the face of macroeconomic pressures, analysts Nikolaos Lafioniatis and Piral Dadhania at RBC Capital Markets write in a note. The Italian luxury-fashion house nudged up its sales views for the year after growth picked up pace in the third quarter, driven by a strong retail performance. That momentum places Cucinelli toward the top of the luxury peer group, Lafioniatis and Dadhania say. "Overall, a strong print for Brunello Cucinelli...re-confirming resilience," they say. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
